verdict.identity: Gascoyne River system; representative mainstem identity only
verdict.status: Supported representative system/mainstem identity; uniform whole-group naming is not cleared.
verdict.identity_confidence: High for representative system identity and lower-course association; upper-branch and individual-reach naming unresolved.
verdict.scope: The existing selected baseline group, not a complete basin inventory or blanket label for its component parts.
verdict.korean_note: No direct Korean naming evidence acquired.

geometry_integrity.review_note: All decoded parts were included in the full path plot and numerical count, bounds and hash checks. Equal part/reach counts do not independently prove the source-to-rendered-part crosswalk.

spatial_identity_check.method: Side-by-side visual comparison of the complete decoded baseline path with complete regional Figures 11.1 and 11.22, plus lower-river official usage. No georegistered overlay or exact line fit.
spatial_identity_check.regional_course_comparison: The long westward path, conspicuous northward middle bend and coastal approach agree with the mapped Gascoyne corridor and official lower-Gascoyne usage around Carnarvon. The separately mapped Lyons corridor is not adopted as a synonym.
spatial_identity_check.bounded_unresolved_scope: The eastern headwater selection beginning at approximately 119.860,-25.063 and all precise branch-name transitions remain unverified. Neither regional map nor the lower-river factsheet is an authoritative 252-part name crosswalk.

outlet_scope.endpoint_interpretation: Retained source-endpoint metadata and decoded render endpoint are separate baseline facts. Neither is established as a surveyed contemporary river mouth.

remaining_limits: Representative identity is supported; whole-group scalar and per-reach naming remain false.
Regional cartography cannot certify headwater name transitions, each minor channel, or a source-reach name crosswalk.
Only pinned historical-baseline geometry was checked; original HydroRIVERS coordinate equality and current deployment are not claimed.
